title: WebView Models
description: WebView interaction models for inspecting and controlling embedded web content.

WebViewContextsResponse.description: Registered CDP WebViews, including inactive or not-yet-ready registrations.

WebViewContext.description: Represents a discovered WebView context within the application.

id.description: Selection alias: AutomationId when nonblank, otherwise elementId when nonblank, otherwise the decimal registry index. Not guaranteed unique when aliases are reused.

index.description: Registry index; its decimal string can select this registration.

automationId.description: AutomationId supplied when registering the CDP bridge.

active.description: Whether the registered owner is visible on an active page in any MAUI window. Ownerless backends use elementId or AutomationId correlation.

hostKind.description: Descriptive hosting metadata: webview, hybrid or blazor. It does not identify the native UI backend or select behavior.

elementId.description: Identifier linking this WebView to its corresponding element in the native UI tree.

url.description: Current URL loaded in the WebView.

title.description: The current handler emits null; it does not query the page title.

ready.description: Readiness reported by the registered CDP bridge.

isReady.description: Alias of ready, emitted by the existing handler.

EvaluateRequest.description: Raw CDP command forwarded unchanged to the selected bridge. To evaluate JavaScript, use method Runtime.evaluate and put expression and returnByValue in params.

params.description: Method-specific CDP parameters. Context selection uses the webview query parameter, not the command body.

EvaluateResponse.description: Raw CDP response returned unchanged by the bridge. For Runtime.evaluate, the remote object is nested under result.result and exceptionDetails, when present, is inside result.

id.description: CDP command identifier when supplied by the bridge.

error.description: CDP error returned by the bridge, without conversion to an HTTP error.

DomQueryRequest.description: Request to query the DOM using a CSS selector.

selector.description: CSS selector to query the DOM.

WebViewNavigateRequest.description: Request to navigate a WebView to a URL.

url.description: URL to navigate the WebView to.

WebViewInputClickRequest.description: Request to click an element within a WebView using a CSS selector.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click.

WebViewInputFillRequest.description: Request to fill text into a WebView input element identified by a CSS selector.

selector.description: CSS selector of the input element to fill.

text.description: Text content to fill into the input element.

WebViewInputTextRequest.description: Request to type text into the currently focused element within a WebView.

text.description: Text to type into the focused element.
